messages:
anya: Quick sync — AuroraPulse case study confirmed. Interview Wed Sep 10 2025 10:00am PT. Deliverables: short blog (600-900w), product page testimonial, 30s and 15s promo clips. Need quote + logo license + metric permission by Mon Sep 8 EOD.

novi: I'll own recording + capture a clean headshot frame. Can someone draft the quote we send them? Also ask about embargo — they mentioned coordinating with a partner release.

sam: Draft quote to propose (please review):
```
"Redwood let us bring real-time insights to customers quickly, without reworking our inference stack." — Kiran P., Head of Product, AuroraPulse
```
I'll send that and request SVG logo and publish permission.

devin: Legal note: if they give any numeric metrics we must have a written approval line with signer and date. Request the exact wording to publish. Also avoid mentioning competitor names in quotes.

anya: Headline idea options (react):
1) "AuroraPulse ships live insights with Redwood Inference"
2) "How AuroraPulse lowered latency and shipped real-time features"
React :one: or :two:.

novi: Recording checklist: mic test 10m prior, local backup, capture 4k still for hero. I'll add chapters for easy clip pulling: intro, demo, metrics, close.

sam: Outreach snippet I'll DM Kiran: > Hi Kiran — thanks again. Can you confirm the quote below? Also can you attach the AuroraPulse SVG logo and let us know if the metric below is publishable? If you give permission please include a short line: "Approved for public release by AuroraPulse, [date]".

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "AuroraPulse case study interview" Wed Sep 10 10:00am PT — Recording link: https://meet.redwood.example/aurorapulse-4567

devin: One more legal tweak to the quote: change "reworking our inference stack" -> "reworking infrastructure" to avoid technical ambiguity. Otherwise looks fine.

anya: Updated quote for send: 
```
"Redwood let us bring real-time insights to customers quickly, without reworking infrastructure." — Kiran P., Head of Product, AuroraPulse
```
Please flag any other edits in the next 30m.

novi: Will ask during outreach whether they want an embargo and what date. If yes, we'll schedule CMS embargo and mark lead routing.

sam: Also thinking ahead on leads: we'll tag inbound demo interest as case_aurorapulse_launch and route to AE team North as default. Ops, can you confirm zap mapping?

ops-bot: Ops note: Zap can set lead tags case_aurorapulse_launch and lead_source=case_study at publish. Need the form param to map "interest=demo".

devin: Legal checklist: collect SVG, the approval line, and store email in legal approvals folder. If customer requests redlines, route to legal@redwood.example and cc PR.

sam: Sending DM to Kiran now. Will paste reply here when it comes in.

(35m later)

sam: Kiran replied in DM: "Quote approved with the infrastructure tweak. Attaching SVG. We can publish a 14% median latency improvement — please include wording: 'Approved for public release by AuroraPulse, Sep 5 2025.' Prefer embargo until Sep 17 to align with partner launch." Attaching logo link: /shared/marketing/aurorapulse/logo.svg

devin: Received approval line. Legal sign-off logged. We'll require the exact stat wording in the draft and add footer: "Approved for public release by AuroraPulse, Sep 5 2025."

novi: Great — embargo to Sep 17. I'll capture the 4k frame and timestamp where Kiran mentions the 14% stat so editors can pull a clip. Uploading assets + chapters to /shared/marketing/aurorapulse after the call.

anya: Draft social blurb options for team vote (react):
A) Product-first: "AuroraPulse uses Redwood Inference to power real-time insights with predictable latency."
B) Outcome-first: "AuroraPulse cut median latency by 14% and shipped live insights to customers."
React :A: or :B:.

sam: Also drafting a 90s webinar promo if they want co-hosted. Short: "Join AuroraPulse and Redwood to see how real-time insights moved from prototype to production — live demo + Q&A."

ops-bot: CMS embargo scheduled for Sep 17 09:00am PT. Zap config noted for lead tags at publish.

devin: Legal final step: once PR drafts the post, send final copy to legal for a quick stamp before publishing. We'll confirm footer and archive approval.

anya: Final actions: Sam -> finalize outreach and paste final approvals; Novi -> record + upload frames + chapters; Devin -> legal sign-off at draft stage; Ops -> confirm zap and schedule embargo. Thanks team. :sparkles:

(End thread — assets and approval stored in /shared/marketing/aurorapulse, embargo set Sep 17)
